content_sections.heading: GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Chief General Manager/General Manager (Civil): B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a Government-recognized University/Institute recognized by the State/Central Government or other statutory authority. Manager (Traction): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute. Asst. Manager (Rolling Stock): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Power Electronics/Instrumentation or equivalent discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute. Engineer - Sr. Grade (M&P): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Power Electronics/Instrumentation engineering or equivalent discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute. Engineer - Jr. Grade (Rolling Stock): B.E./B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics & Communications/Mechanical/Electrical & Electronics/Power Electronics/Instrumentation engineering or equivalent discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute. Candidates with experience of working in modern urban metro rail systems will be given preference for all posts. For Civil posts, candidates with proven experience of timely project completion as heads of site teams shall be preferred, and must mention a reference from Senior Management who oversaw those projects.

rows.experience_requirement: Minimum 23 years post-qualification experience in a reputed private organization; OR minimum 20 years in Government Organizations/Indian Railways/PSUs/Metro Rail Corporations, of which at least 17 years at Executive level, including minimum 4 years in SAG/GM grade (7th CPC Level-14 or IDA scale ₹120000-280000 or equivalent)

Minimum 20 years post-qualification experience in a reputed private organization; OR minimum 17 years in Government Organizations/Indian Railways/PSUs/Metro Rail Corporations, of which at least 14 years at Executive level

Minimum 9 years post-qualification experience in a reputed private organization, OR 7 years in Government organisation/PSU/Metro Rail Corporation, in planning, technical specification, contract administration, installation, testing, commissioning, statutory approvals, or maintenance of electric traction/HV Power systems
Minimum 7 years relevant post-qualification experience at Supervisory grade in a reputed private organization, OR 5 years at Supervisory grade in Government/PSU, related to Rolling Stock systems

Minimum 3 years post-qualification relevant experience in tender document preparation, contract administration, installation, testing, commissioning, or maintenance of Machines & Plants in modern urban metro rail systems or railways
Minimum 2 years relevant experience in planning, technical specification, contract administration, installation, testing, commissioning, statutory approvals, or maintenance of Rolling Stock systems

content_sections.heading: GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is not mentioned in the official GMRC notifications for either the Civil or Systems posts. Candidates are advised to check the official website, gujaratmetrorail.com, for any fee-related updates or corrigenda before applying.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises Personal Interviews, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. Preference is given to candidates with experience in the same grade or immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in that grade. If sufficient suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale meeting the prescribed qualifications, total experience, and age criteria may be considered. The selection process evaluates knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude, and physical fitness. The venue, date, and time of the interview will be informed in advance; requests for change in date or venue will not be entertained. Document verification of candidates will be done before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates; failing this, they will not be allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Detailed curriculum vitae Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate Educational Qualification: SSC marksheet/HSC marksheets/Graduation all-year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates Experience/service certificates of past employment, clearly mentioning date of joining, date of relieving, and department worked, along with pay details/payscale/CTC Candidates from private organizations must submit a copy of their latest CTC breakup; applications without CTC breakup will not be considered. Form-16 will be used to arrive at current CTC. Details of current organization: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip, and Form-16 of the last three years Candidates working in PSU/Boards/Organization of Government/Metro Rail Corporations must submit an NOC along with the last 5 years' APAR of the present/previous organization, on or before the date of interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates fulfilling the eligibility norms may apply through the online application process at the "Careers" section on the official website, http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com . Only online applications are accepted; no other means or mode of application will be entertained. Step 1: Register on the portal using basic details such as Name, DOB, category, mobile number, and email ID. Step 2: A passcode will be sent to the registered email ID. Log in using the credentials. Step 3: Select the position for which you are applying. Step 4: Fill in the online application with relevant details, latest to earliest. Step 5: Complete the application form. Step 6: Check the entered details using the "preview" option available. Step 7: Submit the form after verifying all the information. Once submitted, the form cannot be edited.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications for both the CGM/GM (Civil) post and the Systems posts is 12th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies for Chief General Manager/General Manager (Civil) and 5 vacancies across Systems posts (Manager, Assistant Manager, and Engineer grades), making a total of 11 vacancies. The number of posts may vary based on further assessment.
